name: Realm of the Mad God Exalt

Optimal.Notes: Native 1280x800 at medium settings delivers a clean pixel-art presentation with stable 60 fps; 6 W TDP is more than sufficient for this lightweight title and leaves good battery headroom. In-game option names are estimated from typical Unity MMO settings.

profiles.Summary: Realm of the Mad God Exalt is a lightweight 2D pixel-art bullet hell MMO that runs well within the Steam Deck's capabilities, requiring only modest GPU resources and comfortably hitting 60 fps even at low TDP. As a free-to-play Unity-based title with minimal graphics overhead, it should run smoothly on Deck under Proton with little tuning needed.
profiles.BasisNote: No Deck-specific player reports were available; profiles are estimated from the PC minimum requirements (GTX 650 class) and the game's lightweight 2D pixel-art nature. On your first run, check that the login and patcher work under Proton Experimental, and verify the frame rate holds steady in busy multiplayer areas with many bullet effects on screen.

MaxBattery.Notes: At 4 W TDP and a low GPU clock, this 2D pixel game barely stresses the hardware; FSR upscaling from 960x600 keeps the display sharp. In-game option names are estimated from typical Unity MMO settings as no Deck-specific guides were found.

KnownIssues: The game requires an active internet connection at all times; offline play is not possible.
Unity-based launcher/patcher may occasionally require manual Proton workarounds on first launch.
Controller/gamepad support is not officially stated; keyboard and mouse input via touchscreen or trackpad may be needed for menus.
In-App Purchases and account login screens may have UI scaling issues at 1280x800.

MaxPerformance.Notes: Even at highest settings this 2D pixel MMO won't challenge the Deck GPU; Nearest-neighbor scaling preserves the crisp pixel-art look at native resolution. A higher TDP allowance is set only as a ceiling — actual consumption will likely remain well below 10 W.

Optimal.Notes: 60 fps at medium quality is well within the Deck's reach for this lightweight 2D title; Integer scaling preserves the pixel-art aesthetic and the modest 6 W TDP keeps thermals and fan noise low. Verify option names under Settings > Video in the Exalt client.

profiles.Summary: Realm of the Mad God Exalt is a lightweight 2D pixel-art bullet hell MMO that runs well within the Steam Deck's capabilities, with ProtonDB trending platinum indicating solid Proton compatibility. The game's modest system requirements and 2D nature mean the Deck can easily hit high frame rates at low TDP, making battery life the primary tuning lever rather than raw GPU performance.
profiles.BasisNote: No Deck-specific player reports were available; profiles are estimated from the game's lightweight 2D pixel-art nature, modest PC minimum requirements (GTX 650), and ProtonDB gold/trending-platinum compatibility tier. On first run, check that the game launches correctly under Proton Experimental, confirm the actual in-game settings menu options, and verify the frame rate holds in crowded multiplayer areas — if it dips, reduce TDP or lower particle/lighting settings.

MaxBattery.Notes: At 4 W TDP with a fixed low GPU clock, this 2D game runs locked at 40 fps with minimal power draw; Integer scaling keeps pixel art crisp at native resolution. Option names are typical for the Unity-based Exalt client — verify under Settings > Video in-game.

KnownIssues: Steam Deck is rated Playable (not Verified), likely due to small UI elements or text that may be hard to read at 1280x800 without a mouse
No native controller support listed — on-screen keyboard or touchscreen may be needed for chat and some UI interactions
As an online-only MMO, gameplay requires a stable internet/Wi-Fi connection; poor connectivity will cause lag regardless of settings
In-App Purchases and account login UI may require touchscreen or trackpad navigation

MaxPerformance.Notes: This 2D game can realistically sustain 90 fps on the OLED Deck even at max quality settings; the 10 W TDP cap prevents unnecessary power draw while leaving headroom for busy bullet-hell encounters. Verify option names under Settings > Video in the Exalt client.
